retirement: Nine pre-start illustrations removed from project and retained outside project for undo/audit. One obsolete import script retired. No dates falsified.
ownerMedia: Owner confirms all supplied music, films and narrator recordings were produced after cutoff. Original generation time not independently verified.
historicalSources: Original NASA images, original NASA 3D models, NASA podcast source excerpts, fonts, licenses and libraries retain their original source history; these are not claimed as new project productions.
planningFiles: AGENTS.md and .gitignore are pre-event planning/repository configuration, not new product content. Local credential files and Git history are untouched and excluded from publication.
derivatives: Some post-start ImageGen room/branding/Viking generations used owner design references as style or edit inputs. They are new outputs after cutoff, with derivative origin preserved; not claimed as entirely independent of pre-event design.
webOptimization: 18 decorative PNGs converted to WebP at original dimensions with exact alpha retained. One unused monitor atlas removed. Original generated PNGs archived outside published project; original production times retained.
displayDisclosure: Owner requested removal of repeated on-image and interface AI labels. Tools and AI origins are described in one production-information card; source metadata retained. Embedded arrival-video credits remain. This card-only illustration disclosure is not represented as equivalent to the competition visible-watermark requirement.
